mainEntity.name: How do I bookmark a verse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press the verse number and choose the bookmark in the bar that opens, or type "mark jn 3:16" in the palette. Bookmarks are listed in the Bookmarks pane.

mainEntity.name: How do I bookmark several verses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press the first verse number, then Shift-press the last; the bookmark then covers the whole run.
